opportunitySummary: Building an AI-powered call preparation web app for freelancers that generates structured briefs from job posts and messages.

clientNeedsBreakdown.main: Develop an AI-driven call prep web application using React and NestJS with LLM API integration.
hidden: Clear communication skills for discovery calls
Previous portfolio of sales or prep tooling

discoveryQuestions: What specific job post and message formats must the AI parse first?
How do you envision the ideal structure of the generated call brief?
Are you using OpenAI or another LLM provider for the backend?
What does a successful MVP look like at the end of the 3-4 weeks?
How would you like to handle twice-weekly syncs and feedback loops?
risks: Scope creep regarding the depth of the AI brief generation
Ambiguous definition of the 'similar prep/sales tooling' requirement
Tight timelines for scheduling the discovery call and proving domain expertise
suggestedPositioning: Full-stack engineer specializing in React, NestJS, and LLM integrations, ready to deliver a production-ready AI call preparation MVP within 3-4 weeks. Backed by experience building AI workflow tools, I focus on clear async communication and structured execution to keep scope tight and aligned with your $2,000 budget.
recomendedSolutionApproach: I will build a robust web app using a React frontend and NestJS backend integrated with OpenAI/Gemini APIs to parse job posts and messages into actionable briefs. To mitigate scope creep, we will follow a milestone-driven MVP approach with twice-weekly syncs to refine AI outputs, ensure high reliability, and ship within the 3-4 week timeline.
callStrategy: Position yourself as an experienced full-stack LLM developer ready to deliver the MVP within 3-4 weeks. Emphasize your structured milestone approach to keep the AI brief generation within scope and budget.
finalPrepNote: Have a portfolio piece of an AI workflow tool ready to share. Confirm your alignment with their $2,000 budget early.
